subject: Pricing the lobby
body:
Hi Oren,

The lobby panels are a good fit for our CNC. Our material cost on the lobby is about 9,000, so there is plenty of profit at 21,000. I will finish the quote tonight.

Dana

flags.quote: Our material cost on the lobby is about 9,000
flags.label: economics

subject: Re: the dental job
body:
Mira,

If they want the cheaper laminate, I am happy to drop to 14,000. Do not tell them that yet.

Wren

flags.quote: I am happy to drop to 14,000
flags.label: negotiation

subject: Fitter availability
body:
Hi Kit,

Hal will not be on site next week. He is in hospital having his knee operated on after the fall. Joss will take over.

Dana

flags.quote: He is in hospital having his knee operated on
flags.label: personal

subject: Weekend collection
body:
Hi Tomasz,

You can collect the doors on Saturday. The side gate lock is broken, so just walk round to the yard. The doors are wrapped by the shutter.

Joss

flags.quote: The side gate lock is broken
flags.label: access

subject: Re: council meeting
body:
Ines,

We met the council estates team again. Their surveyor is an arrogant fool and wasted the whole morning. We still have the job.

Hal

flags.quote: Their surveyor is an arrogant fool
flags.label: remark

subject: Notes on the bid
body:
Hi Petra,

The bid went in at 48,000. We put a 20 percent margin and 4,000 of contingency into that number. Fingers crossed.

Wren

subject: Your markup
body:
Hi Oren,

Thanks for your markup on the joinery drawings. We have taken all of it on board for revision E.

Dana

subject: Keys at handover
body:
Hi Mira,

The keys for every locker are in the top drawer of the reception desk. There is a list with the locker numbers.

Hal

subject: Our quote
body:
Hi Kit,

Our quote for the second floor is 17,250 plus fitting. We can start in May.

Wren

subject: Thursday
body:
Hi Tomasz,

Joss is out on Thursday, so I will bring the samples myself. See you at ten.

Dana

subject: Re: finish
body:
Hi Petra,

The lacquer on the sample is too glossy for the brief. We will send a matt version next week.

Joss

subject: Delivery booked
body:
Hi Ines,

The delivery is booked for 7am at the north gate. Two people will unload.

Hal
